scripts.build: bun run build:ws && bun run build:mod
scripts.build:mod: bun run build:mod:agent-board && bun run build:mod:commit-history
scripts.build:mod:agent-board: bun build herdr-app/src/agent-board/main.ts --outfile dist/mods/agent-board/main.js --format esm --target browser --external herdr --external gpui-kit && cp herdr-app/mod/agent-board/* dist/mods/agent-board/ && bun herdr-app/build/pie-svgs.ts dist/mods/agent-board/pie
scripts.build:mod:commit-history: bun build herdr-app/src/commit-history/main.ts --outfile dist/mods/commit-history/main.js --format esm --target browser --external herdr --external gpui-kit && cp herdr-app/mod/commit-history/* dist/mods/commit-history/
